# Workspace instructions

Before working in this repository, read and follow [AGENT.md](../AGENT.md), the canonical Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, testing, accessibility, and security standards. Apply it to every task and review; do not duplicate its detailed rules here.

- Preserve user changes and existing behavior; do not perform unrelated migrations.
- Use project-local Node.js and Angular CLI through npm scripts. Never change global Angular or system Node.js.
- Use the configured Angular MCP tools when available for version-specific guidance; report unavailability honestly.
- Validate changes with the relevant checks from AGENT.md and report actual results and exceptions.
